Type: upholstered dining chair, set of two
Use: dining, working at a desk; dining room, home office
Style: contemporary, mid-century modern, minimalist
Materials: woven fabric upholstery with piping, solid wood legs
Colors: light warm grey, medium natural wood
Shape: armless, curved scoop back sloping to the seat, padded seat, four tapered wooden legs, clean and medium weight
Feel: calm, soft, understated
Goes with: oak or walnut tables, white or grey walls, neutral textiles; modern or transitional dining rooms

product.description: Hints of mid-century, including sloping armless sides and a tall curved back, combine with traditional fabric for a transitional style that will blend with a variety of décor.
